objects.name: Process Discovery
objects.description: [Inception](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0100) has used a reconnaissance module to identify active processes and other associated loaded modules.(Citation: Symantec Inception Framework March 2018)

objects.name: System Information Discovery

objects.x_analyst_notes: MITRE ATT&CK actor-level procedure example. No activity period is inferred from source publication or relationship modification dates.

objects.name: Encrypted/Encoded File
objects.description: [Inception](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0100) has encrypted malware payloads dropped on victim machines with AES and RC4 encryption.(Citation: Kaspersky Cloud Atlas December 2014)

objects.name: Web Service
